concerns.text: FR-001 mandates generation using 'two open-source LLM checkpoints' (TinyLlama + 7B). Task T012 (runner_local.py) is marked [FAILED: unspecified] and T013 is malformed. No active task covers the mandatory 7B checkpoint generation required by the spec, leaving a core functional requirement unimplemented.

FR-001 explicitly requires 'retry up to 3 times' on generation failure. Task T010 ('Implement retry logic') is marked as incomplete [ ]. No other task covers this specific retry mechanism, leaving a critical functional requirement unaddressed.

FR-011 requires sensitivity analysis on Cohen's κ threshold. Task T022 ('Implement Cohen's κ calculation and threshold sensitivity analysis') is marked as incomplete [ ]. No other task covers this specific sensitivity analysis, leaving a functional requirement unimplemented.

FR-012 requires testing ANOVA assumptions (Shapiro-Wilk, Levene) and switching to Kruskal-Wallis if violated. Task T018 ('Implement stats.py... Run Shapiro-Wilk and Levene tests') is marked as incomplete [ ]. No other task covers this logic, leaving a functional requirement unimplemented.

SC-002 requires a stratified random sample of 10 reports per condition for human rating. Task T023 ('Create stratified_sampler.py') is marked as incomplete [ ]. No other task covers this sampling logic, leaving a success criterion unaddressed.

Task T013 contains malformed YAML/regex comments ('<!-- SKIPPED: YAML+regex parse failed...') and is marked incomplete. This indicates a broken task definition that needs rewriting to properly cover timeout handling and sample-size logging.

Task T020 is duplicated with conflicting IDs and descriptions (once as 'validity_justification.py' for FR-009, once as 'rubric.md' for FR-010). This ID collision creates ambiguity and risks one of the requirements (FR-009 or FR-010) being missed.

Tasks T034-T036 and T040-T044 are tagged as 'Review-Driven Enhancements' based on simulated comments (Turing, Rockmore, etc.) but lack explicit [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tags linking them to the spec. While the descriptions mention FRs, the lack of explicit tags makes traceability ambiguous and risks these being treated as unapproved scope creep.
